title: Sue Peulawanan .
intro: Treb that sigohlom manusia phon jijak ateueh bumoe, sidroe makhlok nyang that-that meukuasa jidong lam ranah damé nyang samporeuna, jikeulileng lé jiwa-jiwa nyang paleng seutia. Watee saboh peurintah geubri, tiep-tiep su geutundok-teuma saboh su geubeudoh geulawan, dan peulawanan nyan akan meugema lam tiep-tiep jameun sampoe uroe akhe. Soe makhluk nyang ka rhet nyoe?
clues: Lon teupeujeuet nibak sapeue-sapeue nyang meu-apui-apui, seudangkan nyang laén di siblah ulôn teupeugot nibak peue nyang awaknyan jak.
Lon tinggai bak teumpat suci lamkawan makhlok-makhlok nyang seutia, sampoe saboh peurintah mantong jipeubalek banmandum.
Watée peurintah nyan teuka, banmandum jiwa jisujut keucuali keu ulôn; tulak ulôn lahé nibak sombong.
Ulôn teupeuteubiet nibak teumpat suci nyan, teutanda ngon kutokan nyang teutab keu siumu masa.
Lon meulakèe watèe sampoe uroe kiamat, dan watée nyan geubri. Ulôn meujanji keu lôn peurab ubak tieb-tieb jiwa dan lôn peusesat awaknyan.
Meunyoe beureuguih jimeusu, ureuëng-ureuëng nyang seutôt ulôn teuma meubagi nasib ulôn, meugabong deungon ulôn lam apui nyang hu meuhu-hu dipat hana ureuëng nyang hase jipeuseulamat awaknyan.

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
